trigger_condition: WorkflowPoolConfig created with min_size > max_size (e.g. 10 and 5)
potential_consequence: Warmup loop compiles excess graphs then discards all beyond ceiling; wasted CPU per refill cycle

trigger_condition: Teams feature enabled, X-Teams-Sender-Email present; billing_user passed as positional user
potential_consequence: Access control runs against end-user not the service account; 403 when end-user lacks assistant access

trigger_condition: Category string longer than any reasonable bound submitted (no per-item max_length)
potential_consequence: Unbounded strings stored in JSONB column; may exceed DB or serialisation limits silently

trigger_condition: chargeback_attribution set to any string outside 'project'/'cost_center' via API
guard_snippet: if chargeback_attribution not in ('project', 'cost_center'): raise ValidationException(...)
potential_consequence: DB CheckConstraint violation surfaces as unhandled 500 instead of 400 to caller
active_sub_execution_id never set; interrupted child cannot be resumed; duplicate execution created on retry

trigger_condition: _compile_graph accesses any WorkflowExecutor attribute not manually set on shell
potential_consequence: AttributeError in warmup thread or at acquire() time; execution silently falls back or crashes refill loop

trigger_condition: child stream() returns without setting terminal status (overall_status remains IN_PROGRESS)
guard_snippet: if finished_child.overall_status not in (SUCCEEDED,): raise SubWorkflowExecutionError(...)
potential_consequence: Parent state machine advances with partial or empty output treated as successful completion

trigger_condition: categories explicitly set to None via API update or YAML null; downstream iterates without null-check
potential_consequence: TypeError: 'NoneType' is not iterable in any consumer that does 'for c in config.categories'

trigger_condition: Confluence space with more pages than the old max_pages limit
guard_snippet: loaded_count = 0; if self.max_pages and loaded_count >= self.max_pages: break
potential_consequence: All pages fetched with no upper bound; memory exhaustion for large spaces

trigger_condition: Transient Confluence API error during _search_content_by_cql call in lazy_load
guard_snippet: wrap _search_content_by_cql call with tenacity retry or restore paginate_request override
potential_consequence: Single transient error aborts the entire load; no retry attempted; indexing silently incomplete
